profile.headline: Flight Software Engineer @ Boeing
profile.summary:
Hi! I am a flight software engineer @ Boeing. I studied data science and computer science at the University of California, Berkeley. My interests lie in the applications of software development, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence in a wide range of industries, including Tech, Aerospace, Earth Science, and Defense. 

Feel free to connect with me, email me at ericlin@berkeley.edu, or send me an InMail!

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer
positions.locationName: El Segundo, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of acceptance tests for all serial, USB, video,  PCIe, ethernet, and power connections on a mission & flight critical Tiger Lake processor board. Guided development of intuitive and comprehensive test suite to completion in under 50% of projected delivery time to meet and exceed the customer’s expected date of delivery.
• Developed Linux drivers in C and Python to enable control of embedded microcontrollers and other devices.
• Designed and implemented system health, status, and data monitors for mission computer test stations.
• Identified, diagnosed, and resolved critical software bugs in legacy drivers and data monitors.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Device Drivers · Test Automation · System Monitoring

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained modular training and simulation software for Predator UAV customers and various supporting systems.
• Performed tasks across the entire SDLC, including interfacing with customers to develop CONOPS, hunting down and addressing critical bugs, and producing high quality features as specified by the end user.
• Collaborated with team of 7 and members of external programs to ensure all components of the UAV simulation software work in tandem.
• Completed 20+ software change requests from the requirement analysis stage to the deployment stage, along with 1,000+ hours of investigating bugs and updating legacy code to MIRSA-C standards.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Analyzed and validated the Global Real-Time Earthquake and Tsunami Detection System as a part of the Ocean Circulation and Air Sea Interaction Group (329B) in JPL’s Earth Science Division.
• Designed, wrote, and implemented a suite of Python scripts that extract and parse earthquake and tsunami data from JPL, USGS, NOAA, and IRIS into Pandas and Excel databases.
• Generated statistical figures using Matplotlib, NumPy, and SciPy to evaluate the earthquake and tsunami models used in the JPL system.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Completed software development and hardware commissioning tasks for the Decadal Survey Optical Testbed and other instruments in JPL’s High Contrast Imaging Testbed Facility (HCIT) as part of the High Contrast Imaging Group (383A).
• Devised, programmed, and implemented a vacuum pump fail-safe system into the vacuum chamber watchdog network within the HCIT. This involved choosing and installing hardware, as well as writing Python scripts to interface with the hardware and send commands remotely and autonomously.
• Characterized a Deformable Mirror Mount by applying voltage to crystal-piston motors and analyzing reflected light using an interferometer, tuned a thermal PID controller by using an existing GUI and debugging C code, and assisted in the installation of the Decadal Survey Testbed.

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped assess the condition of shelter cats and dogs, gave them exercise, and provided companionship.

100+ hours of volunteering experience over the course of my Boy Scout career. Planned, organized, and led an Eagle Service Project totaling 200+ combined volunteer hours across all volunteers, restoring 7 park picnic tables at Arcadia Wilderness Park.

organizations.name: Cal Seismic Design Team
organizations.description: Lead instructor of the analysis module within the Cal Seismic Design Team. Responsible for modeling and performing analysis on our final structural design and teaching usage of the modeling software.

organizations.name: Space Technologies at California (STAC)
organizations.description: Financial Officer of STAC and member of the CubeSat Project Team.
